identity.name: Crossover Stockton
identity.purpose: Crossover aims to help bring post-scarcity into being by engineering practical solutions to real needs. We start in Stockton, learn from people and evidence, and take useful action.

principles.title: Vocation
principles.statement: Moving from working to make a living toward doing what we feel called to do.

principles.title: Compassion
principles.statement: Recognizing our shared unconsciousness and seeing beyond ego, judgment, and division.

principles.title: Reality
principles.statement: Freedom means little if we remain disconnected from the world around us.

principles.title: Discovery
principles.statement: We don't need all the answers before we begin. Each action can reveal the next useful step.

methods.title: Technology
methods.statement: Use AI, robotics, and automation to reduce unnecessary work and expand what people can do.

methods.title: Action
methods.statement: Start with real needs, show up, learn from evidence and experience, take a useful step, and repeat.
